# SWIFT/BIC Codes Database

> SWIFT/BIC codes for banks and financial institutions worldwide. 232 countries, 112,000+ records.

This repository contains a database of swift/bic codes database covering 232 countries with 112,887 records.

## Available Formats

- SQLite database (.db) — ready to query
- SQL dump (.sql) — import into MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, etc.
- Excel, CSV, PDF — available at https://listbase.org

## Data Structure

Table: `swift_codes`
- `country_code` (TEXT NOT NULL)
- `swift_code` (TEXT NOT NULL)
- `bank` (TEXT)
- `city` (TEXT)
- `branch` (TEXT)

## Download

- GitHub Releases: https://github.com/listbase-org/swift-bic-codes-databases/releases
- Excel/CSV/PDF: https://listbase.org/en/finance/
